text: The major is designed to train professionals with basic theory in modern science of economy and management, who know how to apply the information science and technology in business activities. Graduates are qualified for such positions as planning, design, implementation, operation, maintenance and management of e-commerce in enterprises (especially telecommunications enterprises), financial institutions, network operators, and government departments as well. E-commerce is a comprehensive field which integrates modern information technology, international business, financial, economics, law, management, logistics and other areas of modern studies. It utilizes electronic means of electronic information technology and the information networks, to carry out business and trade activities. In the 21st century it is the most promising business model. It puts special emphasis on the courses of management, economics, the modern enterprise management and computer information processing, information resources management, and e-commerce. Furthermore, it attaches importance to the analysis, design and implementation e-commerce, and to the use of modern information technology in network marketing, network financial operations, and e-commerce market research and development. Students in the first two years are trained in accordance with the category of information management to gain a solid theoretical foundation. At the third school year students can choose their specialties in accordance with their own choice to finish their follow-up professional courses.
